title: Row, Row, Row Your Boat: the second phrase
intro: A round for four voices in 6/8, each entering two bars after the last. The second phrase ("gently down the stream") is missing.
phrases: F5/8 F5 F5 C5 C5 C5 | A4 A4 A4 F4 F4 F4
words: Row, row, row your boat, gent -- ly down the stream, mer -- ri -- ly, mer -- ri -- ly, mer -- ri -- ly, mer -- ri -- ly, life is but a dream.
hints: In 6/8 the strong beats are the first and fourth eighth notes of each bar.
The round never leaves the F major chord. Aim for A or C on the strong beats.
The first phrase climbs F-G-A. Keep climbing, by step, toward C5.
